prompts: A small bakery sells bread, cakes and cookies. Each morning the baker prepares fresh dough, bakes several batches and arranges them on shelves before customers arrive. Summarize the daily routine of this bakery in two sentences.

A city library wants to help more students use its services. It currently opens from nine in the morning until six in the evening, offers free wireless internet, lends books for two weeks and runs a reading club every Saturday. Many students say they study late at night, need quiet rooms for group projects and would like to borrow laptops. The library has a limited budget, only four staff members and one small meeting room on the second floor. Suggest three practical changes the library could make within its current budget, and explain each change briefly in a single sentence.
